simulation_type: V18 first-order washout model (REUSED) + Pareto check + 9-point patient variability grid + 30/90/180-day durability + selectivity check
model_derived_label: MODEL_DERIVED — all results from first-order washout with engineering-estimated parameters (ret_eff, degr, drain). NOT in-vitro validated.
key_finding: Multi-mechanism FAILS T5 (Pareto) for peptide and small_molecule — it is dominated by hydrodynamic alone (hydro: 0.484 retention at 92% drainage vs multi: 0.376 retention at 90% drainage). Multi PASSES T1-T4 for antibody only (0.55 retention at 90% drainage, Pareto-optimal). Hydrodynamic alone passes T1+T2+T3 for ALL payloads but FAILS T4 (selectivity) — it is just slowing drainage, not selective. Size-selective alone passes T1+T2+T4 for antibody but FAILS T1 for peptide/small_molecule. No mechanism passes ALL 5 thresholds for ALL 3 payloads. VERDICT: ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE — multi fails, hydrodynamic dominates but is non-selective (not patentable as 'selective retention'), size-selective survives for antibody only (partial survivor).
